Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.database.DatabaseManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
LeaderboardDAO
public class DatabaseManager extends Object implements LeaderboardDAO
JDBC-backed LeaderboardDAO that stores match results in a PostgreSQL (Supabase) database. Connection details are read from the SUPABASE_DB_URL, SUPABASE_DB_USER and SUPABASE_DB_PASS environment variables.

All persistence is best-effort: SQL failures are logged and swallowed rather than propagated, so a database problem never aborts a game — at worst the leaderboard is not updated or comes back empty.

    • saveMatchResults

      public void saveMatchResults(int gameSize, List<EndGameDTO> results, LocalDate date)
      Batch-inserts one row per player into the match_leaderboard table, storing each player's nickname and score together with the game size and date. Only the nickname and score are persisted from each EndGameDTO; rank, food and winner flag are not stored. Any SQLException is logged and swallowed.

    • getGlobalLeaderboard

      public List<EndGameDTO> getGlobalLeaderboard(int gameSize)
      Reads the all-time leaderboard for the given game size: it keeps each nickname's best score (via Postgres DISTINCT ON) and orders the result from highest to lowest score, assigning a 1-based rank by position. The returned EndGameDTOs carry the stored nickname, score and date; food is set to 0 and the winner flag to false, since those are not persisted. Any SQLException is logged and swallowed, yielding an empty list.
      Specified by:
      getGlobalLeaderboard in interface LeaderboardDAO
      Parameters:
      gameSize - the player count whose leaderboard to read
      Returns:
      the ranked leaderboard entries, or an empty list if none exist or a query fails
